title: Chemical tools for discriminating single nucleotide variants: from design principles to clinical applications
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS01006C, Review Article
Dan Huang, Yao Liu, Guan Alex Wang, Sitong Lv, Yun Tan, Feng Li
This review provides a comprehensive overview of design principles and clinical applications of chemical tools for recognizing, discriminating, and enriching single nucleotide variants.
